subject: Next steps: Environment choice & PoC scope for Olive Health
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie@olivehealth.com>, Marcus Liao <marcus.liao@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps after call — environment choice & PoC scope

Thanks again for the time earlier, Julie and Marcus — quick recap + proposed next steps so we can land on deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) and finalize a short PoC.

Call highlights (very condensed):
- Primary goal: integrate Redwood for clinical-note summarization and structured extraction within Olive's intake flow.
- Latency target: median token latency <120ms end-to-end for interactive triage tool.
- Data residency: data-at-rest must remain in Olive-controlled resources for PHI-sensitive objects; streaming may be allowed to hosted endpoints with encryption but prefer Private/Dedicated for full control.
- Estimated QPS: 10–12 concurrent agents during peak hours (~150 reqs/min).

My recommendation based on what we heard:
- Short PoC using Dedicated capacity to validate throughput and latency with realistic traffic; run a parallel config test for Private VPC to validate network/E2E compliance. Hosted API might be suitable later for non-PHI features but not for the core clinical path right now.

Proposed immediate next steps (please confirm):
1) Olive to share ops requirements doc (attached: olive-ops-requirements.docx) and any SOC/compliance contact.
2) Redwood to send a 3-week PoC charter (attached) with goals, success criteria, and required stakeholders.
3) Schedule 60-min PoC kickoff next week with application, security, and infra (we suggest Tue/Wed).
4) If you want, we can include a short Dedicated vs Private VPC cost/latency sketch in the kickoff.

Attachments: redwood-poc-charter.xlsx (stub), redwood-security-brief.pdf (stub)

Thanks — I can book the kickoff once you confirm availability and the ops doc is shared.

– Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | (650) 555-0192
From: Julie Park <julie@olivehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Liao <marcus.liao@olivehealth.com>, cloudops@olivehealth.com
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps after call — environment choice & PoC scope

Thanks, Vivek — this is helpful. A few clarifying points from our side:

- Data residency: anything that stores PHI must be in our VPC or on-prem. We can stream non-PHI to hosted if it simplifies latency, but for the initial PoC we want to validate the fully isolated path.
- QPS: 12 peak concurrent looks right; for the PoC we can simulate 20% higher to test headroom.
- Security: our SOC team needs the Redwood security brief and any SOC 2 attestation; can you confirm what you can share?

Availability: Tue 17 Feb 11:00–12:00 PT would work for a kickoff.

Also, Marcus asked that we capture success criteria explicitly:
- End-to-end P95 latency <250ms for PHI flow on Private VPC (including network hop to our gateway).
- Processing accuracy for extraction tasks: F1 >= 0.88 on the provided validation set.
- No persistent PHI in Redwood-managed logs — we need an audit plan.

We'll upload a short ops requirements doc to the Drive link (will ping once done).

– Julie
Julie Park, Head of Product — Intake Automation | Olive Health
julie@olivehealth.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie@olivehealth.com>, Marcus Liao <marcus.liao@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps after call — environment choice & PoC scope

Appreciate the clarity, Julie. Quick answers and an updated PoC plan below.

Security artifacts: attaching our high-level security brief now (redwood-security-brief.pdf). For SOC 2 reports we can provide an executed NDA-first copy; Marissa will follow up on process and timing.

Updated PoC approach (3 weeks) — running two parallel tracks: Dedicated capacity (fast path) + Private VPC (compliance path). We will:
- Week 0 (kickoff): align owners, ingress/egress, and test dataset upload to your S3.
- Week 1: Dedicated baseline run — validate batching, token throughput, and latency targets with simulated QPS (we'll run +20% headroom).
- Week 2: Private VPC deploy — validate network egress, key management (customer KMS), and audit logs.
- Week 3: Joint evaluation, accuracy measurement vs your validation set, and decision workshop.

Success criteria (to propose formally in the charter):
- Latency: P95 <250ms for Private VPC PHI flow; median <120ms on Dedicated during interactive tests.
- Accuracy: Extraction F1 >= 0.88 (as Julie requested).
- Security: No persistent PHI in Redwood-managed logs; audit log entries for every request and KMS keywrap verification.
- Operational: Deployment week-to-week checklist completed, and a runbook for failover to Dedicated/Hosted if capacity issues appear.

Attachments included: redwood-poc-charter.xlsx (detailed tasks/timeline), redwood-security-brief.pdf

Julie — I tentatively booked Tue 17 Feb 11:00 PT for kickoff; please confirm or propose alternate. If confirmed, we'll send calendar invites and a short pre-kickoff checklist for your infra and security folks.

– Vivek
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Next steps after call — environment choice & PoC scope

Looping in here with a couple of operational notes for the PoC kickoff and what I need from the Olive ops team:

Please ask Olive to provide before kickoff:
- A short network diagram showing their ingress gateway and any NAT/proxy between the VPC and Redwood's endpoints.
- A sample S3 bucket path for test data and an IAM principal we can use for the PoC.
- Contact for KMS/HSM key exchange (name + email).

I'll own the Dedicated sizing and deployment checklist; Marissa will coordinate SOC 2 NDA and receipt of the SOC pack. Vivek — can you confirm whether we need any temporary firewall rules for the Private VPC dry-run? I can draft a minimal template to send to Olive.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman | Incident & Cloud Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
